title: Venture: daily idea scouting
prompt: Automation task. Call forge_run with orchestration "idea-scout" and args_json "{}". It runs in the background (about 10-30 minutes) and writes forge/reports/ideas/<date>.md. Reply with one line: the run id. Do not poll and do not start anything else.

title: Venture: autopilot (build and go live)
prompt: Automation task. Call forge_run with orchestration "venture-autopilot" and args_json "{}". It picks the best approved idea, builds it and takes it live on its own, and skips itself if another autopilot run is active, the weekly limit is reached or forge/reports/ideas/AUTOPILOT-PAUSED exists. Reply with one line: the run id. Do not poll and do not start anything else.

title: Venture: weekly retrospective
prompt: Automation task. Call forge_run with orchestration "weekly-retro" and args_json "{}". It updates the scouting playbook and lens weights and writes forge/reports/ideas/retro-<date>.md. Reply with one line: the run id. Do not poll and do not start anything else.
